lead.title: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 runs 30B-parameter MoE models fully on-device
lead.summary: The 2nm SM8975 unveiled at Snapdragon Summit pairs a 5GHz Oryon CPU with a Hexagon NPU whose new Element Accelerator speeds up prefill by up to ~80% on 3B models, and a 50% larger shared-memory pool enables 30B+ MoE inference locally with a 32,000-token context. Always-on sensing-hub micro-NPUs run 200M-parameter models continuously for transcription and personal memory, out-specing Apple's 20B on-device MoE announced at WWDC.

top_stories.title: Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3 Action, an open-weights 7B world action model you can fine-tune
top_stories.summary: The model takes a camera frame plus a text instruction and predicts the next two seconds of robot actions; fine-tuned on DROID it reports first place on RoboLab at 42.92% success, ahead of the 16B Cosmos 3 Nano policy, and its checkpoints are already integrated into LeRobot.

top_stories.title: llama.cpp v0.5.0 lands with HRM-Text support, CUDA conv2d acceleration and Metal MoE fusions
top_stories.summary: The major release of the inference engine adds HRM-Text (DFM Mimir 1B), MiMo-V2.6 and HunyuanOCR conversions, implicit-GEMM CUDA conv2d speedups, Metal MoE/SSM_CONV fusion optimizations and multi-address HTTP binding for the server.

top_stories.title: TrendForce: Micron's 2GB GDDR7 exit narrows supply options for NVIDIA's RTX 50 series
top_stories.summary: With Micron phasing out its 2GB GDDR7 chips, only costlier 3GB modules remain in its lineup and map poorly onto existing RTX 50 memory bus configurations; the report ties the move to the broader memory crunch and says the RTX 50 Super refresh is reportedly on hold over 3GB GDDR7 pricing.

items.title: UECR-GRPO unifies on-policy distillation and GRPO through entropy-calibrated credit
items.summary: Integrating verifier and teacher signals in a single GRPO-style update with entropy-calibrated token credit redistribution, the method reaches Avg@12 of 17.21% and 65.09% with Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students on five math reasoning benchmarks, beating the strongest baselines at each scale.

items.title: RAMP: adaptive mixed-precision quantization for edge CPU vision models, no GPU needed
items.summary: Benchmarking 13 layer-sensitivity metrics for INT8 across four networks on two ARM64 platforms, Jensen-Shannon Divergence shows zero catastrophic failures where gradient and weight-statistic metrics fail on up to half of configurations; with K-Means policy allocation it is near-lossless at a 1.81x mean speedup.

items.title: MicroQonv reshapes convolution tensors for efficient microscaling in training and inference
items.summary: Combining MX quantization with convolution forward/backward passes via channel-batch-first im2col, it cuts activation quantization overhead up to 9x and memory movement up to 7.53x, and enables 4-bit MX latent replay for continual learning at the edge (+5.7% to +11% accuracy).

items.title: Curvature-priced 'quantization price' tables select PTQ configurations before deployment
items.summary: Formulating weight-space post-training quantization as pre-deployment configuration selection, the work produces a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.

items.title: Small-lab drop: Altworld's Hemmingway-1, a 27B Apache-2.0 Qwen3.8 fine-tune that writes like a human
items.summary: A two-continent micro-lab open-sourced its first model, purpose-built for short, tone-sensitive personal text without the three-option preamble; plain BF16 weights are vLLM-compatible with the MTP layer included, and it takes third place on the independent EQ-Bench 4 leaderboard.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3 Diarization, an open-weight 100M speaker-diarization model
items.summary: A single 100M-parameter model for offline and streaming multi-speaker diarization that NVIDIA ranks first on VoiceArena's diarization leaderboard at a 14.72% Diarization Error Rate, with guidance for speaker-attributed ASR and latency/accuracy trade-offs.

items.title: Basis AI releases Conversations 1500: 1,500 hours of full-duplex speech, free for commercial use
items.summary: The corpus covers full-duplex conversations with 2-4 simultaneous speakers across 22 languages and 2,645 unique speakers, delivered as channel-separated 48 kHz 16-bit mono FLAC, and is free for both commercial and research use.

items.title: Ollama v0.34.4 fixes 'model not found' errors and speeds up Qwen 3.8 on Apple Silicon
items.summary: The patch to the most popular local-model runner applies structured outputs in a single pass on thinking models, fixes intermittent lookup errors with large local libraries, and bumps llama.cpp, MLX and XGrammar.

items.title: Unsloth v0.1.815-beta runs FP8 Qwen-Image-2.1 locally, with 2x faster reasoning blocks
items.summary: The local run/fine-tune UI adds fast FP8 Qwen-Image-2.1 generation and editing, custom Agent Skills, 60 FPS reasoning blocks, in-app updates on Debian, an ARM64 .deb installer and an AMD ROCm Docker image.

items.title: llama.cpp b11117 optimizes HIP quantization kernels for AMD GPUs
items.summary: The build reworks IQ2/IQ3 quant kernels on the HIP backend with SWAR and bit manipulation on __vsub4/__vcmpne4 primitives — relevant to anyone running low-bit GGUF quants on AMD — following b11114's llama-server router-eviction fix and b11113's --no-log flag.

items.title: Serving-stack digest: vLLM v0.30.0 stable, llama.cpp b11115, LiteLLM v1.102.0 security release
items.summary: The daily infrastructure digest advises building llama-server from b11114 or newer for stable routing, using --no-log to avoid child-process log inheritance, and reports no breaking API changes in recent server patches.

items.title: On Apple Silicon, Ollama is MLX under the hood on 32GB+ Macs
items.summary: Since Ollama 0.19, Macs with 32GB or more unified memory run Apple's MLX framework rather than the Metal llama.cpp path, so older MLX-versus-Ollama comparisons no longer describe the same engine; the explainer maps which of llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama and LM Studio to pick and notes both expose OpenAI-compatible local endpoints.

items.title: 4GB and 6GB GDDR7 chips planned for 2027-2028, promising denser VRAM on narrower buses
items.summary: A Videocardz-cited report says new 4GB and 6GB GDDR7 capacities are in development, which would let future GPUs pack substantially more memory per card; today only 2GB and 3GB chips exist, constraining mainstream and workstation card configurations relevant to local LLM workloads.

items.title: Next-gen AMD RDNA 5 'AT2' GPU specs leak: 70 compute units targeting 3.1-3.4 GHz
items.summary: Leaked specs claim a significant step up from the RX 9070 XT with retail cards targeted for 2027; if it lands on GDDR7 it would close much of the memory-bandwidth gap that currently favors NVIDIA's Blackwell cards for inference.

items.title: Banma unveils AutoOmni 2.0-23B-A3B, a 23B omni-modal on-device cockpit LLM
items.summary: At the Apsara Conference the company introduced a 23B MoE omni-modal model (3B active) designed to run entirely on automotive SoCs including Snapdragon Cockpit Elite, claiming routine-task parity with 230B cloud models in cockpit scenarios with 5-6x accelerated inference and 8+ concurrent task streams.
